author: fancy.murray
title: Freesound - On the Tram from Keskturg to Paberi (a bunch of kids got on) - 2024-04-25_11-45am by fancy.murray
description: A short segment of a tram ride on the number 4 tram line from Keskturg to Paberi in which a school group gets on right at the end. Because of the kids' privacy I put away my recorder, sorry to anyone who needed those sounds. Mostly the quiet hum of the electric light rail vehicles (at the time, the number 4 was running the new tram cars). Recorded on a ZOOM-H5 (onboard XY aimed up towards the ceiling of the tram car). Notable sounds:#0:07 Tram begins to pull away from the stoplight#0:30 Tram's "next stop" announcement#1:54 School group gets on P.S. - I have chosen to put this into "Indoor" instead of "Urban" because much of the city noise can not be heard from inside these modern, quite quiet, tram cars.

author: nikohfb
title: Freesound - Berlin Public Transport 9.aif by nikohfb
description: Inside an elderly municipal train ("S-Bahn") leaving the station. A loud compressor operates, over that a loudspeaker announcement, followed by the door warning signal & the doors closing. The train accelerates, the sound of the electric motor rises in pitch. MiniDisc, 1998
